brief: Prioritise Fairmount Heights for pre-event attention because its advanced age of 34 years and high loading history indicate a reduced margin against mechanical failure under a heat event, as outlined in MG-023. Where this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, per MG-023. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021.
